summary: Agent Harness resolved a review-and-repair quality command into a read-only Feature, so the required repair phase was not started.

expected.lifecycle: The quality lifecycle should review findings, execute or schedule the declared repair work, rerun validation, and close only after the repair-aware stop condition is satisfied.

actual.plan: The generated Feature had allowedPaths=[] and explicitly prohibited workspace writes.
actual.consequence: Only the review stage ran; no repair stage was started.
actual.inconsistency: The plan metadata declared sourcePolicy review-and-repair while its Feature contract was read-only.

steps: Run h:engine quality V3.8.4 in the bound engine workspace.
Inspect the generated lifecycle plan and Feature acceptance data.
Observe sourcePolicy review-and-repair together with allowedPaths=[] and a no-workspace-writes requirement.
Observe that the lifecycle reports review findings without entering a repair phase.
